cnr_continue.title: Cops & Robbers: Next step (set up / go)
cnr_continue.desc: No round: set up a round with the next runner. During prep: start it.

cnr_start_next.onDown: if copsAndRobbers then copsAndRobbers.command('start next') end
cnr_start_next.title: Cops & Robbers: Start round: next runner
cnr_start_next.desc: Set up a round with whoever has run least.

cnr_start_again.onDown: if copsAndRobbers then copsAndRobbers.command('start again') end
cnr_start_again.title: Cops & Robbers: Start round: same runner
cnr_start_again.desc: Set up a round with the previous runner.

cnr_start_random.onDown: if copsAndRobbers then copsAndRobbers.command('start random') end
cnr_start_random.title: Cops & Robbers: Start round: random runner
cnr_start_random.desc: Set up a round with a random runner.

cnr_reroll.title: Cops & Robbers: New car
cnr_reroll.desc: Pick a new random car during prep.

cnr_end.title: Cops & Robbers: End chase (record time)
cnr_end.desc: End the chase and record the runner's time.

cnr_stop.title: Cops & Robbers: Cancel round
cnr_stop.desc: Cancel the round without recording it.

cnr_auto.title: Cops & Robbers: Automatic rounds on/off
cnr_auto.desc: Toggle preparing the next round automatically.

cnr_test_runner.onDown: if copsAndRobbers then copsAndRobbers.command('test runner') end
cnr_test_runner.title: Cops & Robbers: Practice as runner
cnr_test_runner.desc: Practice round against two AI cops.

cnr_test_cop.onDown: if copsAndRobbers then copsAndRobbers.command('test cop') end
cnr_test_cop.title: Cops & Robbers: Practice as cop
cnr_test_cop.desc: Practice round with an AI runner.
